03 / PLATFORMER

Platformer

Hop, wall-jump, collect coins.

COINS0
BEST0
Head for the flag. Wall-jump up the tall ledges!

How to play

Reach the flag, collect coins, and bounce on the little critters.

  • ← → or A / D to move
  • Space or ↑ to jump
  • Touch a wall, then jump again to wall-jump

Wall-jump tip

Hold toward the wall, press jump, then steer back right away. Short, repeated wall-jumps climb the ledges.

Take your time. Falling puts you back at the start, and your coins stay with you.

ARROWS OR A / D TO MOVE · SPACE OR ↑ TO JUMP · WALL-JUMP OFF LEDGES
